land.label: ANONYMIZED WORK SAMPLE
land.title: From scattered records to a decision-ready report.
land.intro: The property-review work brings documentary checks, site observations, and recommendations into one structured report. This summary recreates the method without reproducing a client case.

steps.title: Trace the records
steps.body: Organize the ownership chain and supporting transaction records; review encumbrance and release documentation alongside revenue records.

steps.title: Compare the evidence
steps.body: Separate legal and regulatory checks from physical verification, so records, boundary observations, access, and usable extent can be reviewed together.

steps.title: Make the next action clear
steps.body: Bring findings into a category-based review matrix, supporting-document index, and recommendations for further verification or professional review.

land.deliverable: A structured report covering title flow, encumbrance history, compliance, physical verification, market context, recommendations, and supporting records.
land.method: Supporting workflow documents define document sourcing, field and office responsibilities, missing-record follow-up, risk escalation, quality review, and report delivery. Monitoring is documented as a separate service workflow.
land.note: Recreated process summary. Original records, locations, measurements, values, scores, and client findings are withheld.

nomination.label: ANONYMIZED WORK SAMPLE
nomination.title: Build a coherent portfolio from a varied public record.
nomination.intro: I prepared a portfolio for formal nomination proceedings. The work involved bringing biographical material, professional experience, public-service work, and supporting records into a structured document.

steps.title: Organize the material
steps.body: Group the profile into clear themes, including public service, policy work, professional experience, and education.

steps.title: Build a navigable narrative
steps.body: Use a contents structure, section hierarchy, and supporting material to make a wide-ranging record easier to review.

steps.title: Prepare the submission
steps.body: Compile the portfolio for the formal nomination process. My contribution was preparing the document; the subject's achievements belong to the subject.

nomination.deliverable: A structured nomination portfolio bringing profile information and supporting material into a single review document.
nomination.method: This example demonstrates information organization and document preparation. Constituency analysis and leadership briefings are separate responsibilities described in the experience section.
nomination.note: Recreated process summary. Names, photographs, personal history, identifying quotations, and original pages are withheld.
